entries.title: I Corinthians 3:1
segments: But I, Brothers, could not speak to you as men with spiritual insight, but only as worldly-minded-mere infants in the Faith of Christ.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:2
segments: I fed you with milk, not with solid food, for you were not then able to take it. No, and even now you are not able; you are still worldly.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:3
segments: While there exist among you jealousy and party feeling, is it not true that you are worldly, and are acting merely as other men do?

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:4
segments: When one says 'I follow Paul,' and another 'I follow Apollos,' are not you like other men?

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:5
segments: What, I ask, is Apollos? or what is Paul? Servants through whom you were led to accept the Faith; and that only as the Lord helped each of you.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:6
segments: I planted, and Apollos watered, but it was God who caused the growth.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:7
segments: Therefore neither the man who plants, nor the man who waters, is of any account, but only God who causes the growth.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:8
segments: In this the man who plants and the man who waters are one; yet each will receive his own reward in proportion to his own labor.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:9
segments: For we are God's fellow workers; you are God's harvest field, God's building.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:10
segments: In fulfillment of the charge which God had entrusted to me, I laid the foundation like a skillful master-builder; but another man is now building upon it. Let every one take care how he builds;

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:11
segments: For no man can lay any other foundation than the one already laid-Jesus Christ.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:12
segments: Whatever is used by those who build upon this foundation, whether gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or straw,

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:13
segments: The quality of each man's work will become known, for the Day will make it plain; because that Day is to be ushered in with fire, and the fire itself will test the quality of every man's work.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:14
segments: If any man's work, which he has built upon that foundation, still remains, he will gain a reward.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:15
segments: If any man's work is burnt up, he will suffer loss; though he himself will escape, but only as one who has passed through fire.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:16
segments: Do not you know that you are God's Temple, and that God's Spirit has his home in you?

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:17
segments: If any one destroys the Temple of God, God will destroy him; for the Temple of God is sacred, and so also are you.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:18
segments: Let no one deceive himself. If any one among you imagines that, as regards this world, he is a wise man, let him become a 'fool,' that he may become wise.

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:19
segments: For in God's sight this world's wisdom is folly. Scripture tells of-'One who catches the wise in their own craftiness,'

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:20
segments: And it says again-'The Lord sees how fruitless are the deliberations of the wise.'

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:21
segments: Therefore let no one boast about men; for all things are yours--

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:22
segments: Whether Paul, or Apollos, or Kephas, or the world, or life, or death, or the present, or the future-all things are yours!

entries.title: I Corinthians 3:23
segments: But you are Christ's and Christ is God's.
